originalPR199Check: PASS with materialized receipts/private index on Linux
diagnosis: Source-reference arrays inherited filesystem enumeration order, which differs between Windows and POSIX for names such as football*/footContact and passing*/passInterception. Manifest hashes already sort paths; the inventory now sorts its source paths explicitly as well.
scope: Cold inventory generation only; runtime and original match receipts unchanged.
